description: Web accessibility fix style: an HTML signup form lacks a lang attribute, alt text (descriptive for the logo, empty for a purely decorative image), proper label association (some controls have no id yet and the password caption is a bare span), a fieldset with legend for the radio group, and button types. A protected Python checker built on html.parser verifies the accessibility rules and that field names, existing ids, values and the form action stay intact, so the cheap shortcuts (placeholders as labels, renaming ids, dangling label targets) are rejected.
